pages.title: Pampatherium
pages.text: The Pampatherium ($(o)Pampatherium humboldtii$()) is an extinct pampathere that lived in South America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Pampatheres were close relatives of both glyptodonts and armadillos. Unlike the rigid shells of glyptodonts, its armour included movable bands across the middle, much like a modern armadillo.$(br2)Much larger than any living armadillo, Pampatherium was a herbivore that grazed on coarse vegetation.
